description: A Dynamic Island for Windows 11 that shows AI coding tool quotas, usage, music controls and system monitor readings
notes: Settings, themes and API keys are kept in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BrimDeck` and are not removed by uninstallation.

This is the portable build, which can update itself in place. That would replace the files in the Scoop-managed folder, so turn off `Check for updates automatically` in Settings > Updates and use `scoop update brimdeck` instead.
